round2_outcomes.BFE-1_brute_force_429_silent_audit_gap: CLOSED — checkBruteForce() now logs the login_failed event before throwing AppException.tooManyRequests. Verified at AuthService.java:107-114: when either threshold trips, the chain is `Mono.fromRunnable(eventService.logEvent(null, EVENT_LOGIN_FAILED, ip, userAgent, Map.of("reason", "brute_force", "email", email))).then(Mono.error(AppException.tooManyRequests(...)))`. The Runnable fires before the error signal propagates, so the event is recorded before the caller receives the response. EventService.logEvent (line 22-27) is fire-and-forget (subscribe inside, no return), so wrapping it in fromRunnable is the correct construct. AppException.tooManyRequests maps to HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS (AppException.java:32-33), so the caller still receives 429. Verified by AuthServiceTest::login_emailBruteForceLimitReached_logsBruteForceEvent at AuthServiceTest.java:240-251 — the test asserts both the AppException error AND the event invocation with the correct reason metadata.
